## v2.2.0

### Added
- **Bottom taskbar for window switching.** The minimal openbox desktop had no panel, so a window that slipped behind another (a terminal behind Krusader, a dialog, a second app) or was minimized was hard to bring back (issue #26). This release adds a thin dark taskbar along the bottom that lists every open window; click one to bring it to the front. Alt+Tab still cycles windows (Alt+Shift+Tab goes backwards), and middle-clicking the empty desktop shows a full window list. It is built on tint2 (about 1 MB), themed to match the Carbon dark UI. There is no system tray, so leave Krusader's "minimize to tray" off; with the taskbar a normal minimize goes to the bar where you click it back.
